name: Channel Radiance (Mythic)
body:
The divine radiance of your channeled energy is blinding and a bane for darkness and evil.

Prerequisite(s): Channel Radiance.

Benefit(s): The radiance summoned when you channel positive energy functions now as mythic brightest light.
